name: Orlando
summary: The theme-park capital of the world — the full Walt Disney World, Universal's two parks, and the Kennedy Space Center an hour east. Plan on a big, joyful week-plus.

lodging.name: A Disney or Universal resort hotel
lodging.blurb: On-property perks and early park entry; or a value hotel on International Drive.

foodMustTry.name: A Dole Whip & a giant turkey leg
foodMustTry.blurb: The theme-park classics — and dinner at Disney Springs.

days.label: Day 210 — Magic Kingdom
days.summary: The park that started it all.

item.title: Walt Disney World: Magic Kingdom

location.name: Magic Kingdom
location.address: 1180 Seven Seas Dr, Lake Buena Vista, FL

item.blurb: Cinderella Castle, Space Mountain, Pirates, and the nighttime fireworks — the classic Disney day.

days.label: Day 211 — EPCOT
days.summary: The future and the World Showcase.

item.title: Walt Disney World: EPCOT

location.name: EPCOT
location.address: 200 Epcot Center Dr, Lake Buena Vista, FL

item.blurb: Spaceship Earth, Guardians of the Galaxy, and eating and drinking around the World Showcase.

days.label: Day 212 — Hollywood Studios
days.summary: Star Wars and the Twilight Zone.

item.title: Walt Disney World: Hollywood Studios

location.name: Disney's Hollywood Studios
location.address: 351 S Studio Dr, Lake Buena Vista, FL

item.blurb: Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge, the Tower of Terror, and Toy Story Land.

item.title: Walt Disney World: Animal Kingdom

location.name: Disney's Animal Kingdom
location.address: 2901 Osceola Pkwy, Lake Buena Vista, FL

item.blurb: Flight of Passage in Pandora, the Kilimanjaro Safari, and the Tree of Life.

days.label: Day 214 — Free Day
days.summary: Sleep in, hit a water park, or wander Disney Springs. Options below.

freeMenu.title: Disney Springs

location.name: Disney Springs
location.address: 1486 Buena Vista Dr, Lake Buena Vista, FL

freeMenu.blurb: Waterfront shopping, dining, and entertainment — no ticket needed.

freeMenu.title: A Disney water park

location.name: Disney's Typhoon Lagoon
location.address: 1145 E Buena Vista Dr, Lake Buena Vista, FL

freeMenu.blurb: Typhoon Lagoon or Blizzard Beach for a cool-off day.

item.title: Universal Studios Florida
item.blurb: Diagon Alley, the Hollywood Rip Ride Rockit, and the studio-backlot rides.

item.title: Universal's Islands of Adventure
item.blurb: Hogsmeade and the Forbidden Journey, the Velocicoaster, and the Hulk — plus the Hogwarts Express between parks.

days.label: Day 217 — Free Day
days.summary: Rest those feet, or add SeaWorld or ICON Park. Options below.

freeMenu.title: ICON Park & International Drive
freeMenu.blurb: The 400-ft observation wheel and the tourist strip.

item.title: Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex

location.name: Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex
location.address: Space Commerce Way, Merritt Island, FL

item.blurb: The Space Shuttle Atlantis, the Apollo/Saturn V, and the launch pads — an hour east on the Space Coast (a launch, if one's scheduled, is unforgettable).

commute.scenicNote: Southeast to the Atlantic and the start of the Gold Coast.
